physicalNotes: Radius 0.7475 +/- 0.0077 solar radii from Bonomo et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-78 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..33B/abstract): 520,036 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.779 +/- 0.032 solar masses from Bonomo et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-78 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..33B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5058 +/- 50 K from Bonomo et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-78 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..33B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
